name: Muchmore Custom Plastics
old_description: Founded in Albuquerque, New Mexico, MCP started as a small operation, driven by a passion for craftsmanship and an eye for detail. Today, we proudly serve both local and national clients.
about:
Muchmore Custom Plastics, formerly known as Montiel's Custom Plastics, operates from Albuquerque, New Mexico. The family-owned business began as a small shop driven by a passion for craftsmanship and attention to detail, and has served local and national clients for nearly four decades.

The company specializes in custom plastic fabrication, offering design consultation, prototyping, production planning, and finishing services. Its capabilities include CNC cutting to a tolerance of ±0.060 inches, machining, beveling, polishing, and thermoforming of acrylic, polycarbonate, and other sheet plastics. Products range from museum-quality display cases and artist vitrines to sneeze guards, protective shields, lighting diffusers, and custom windshields for marine and recreational vehicles.

Clients span museums, art galleries, and collectors; laboratories, pharmaceutical, and medical facilities; lighting and electrical manufacturers; advertising and point-of-purchase display producers; universities, schools, and offices; hotels and restaurants; and recreational vehicle builders. The shop also serves frame shops, art supply stores, and individual inventors seeking custom plastic parts.

Muchmore emphasizes its family-owned heritage, premium material selection, and a reputation as a museum- and artist-preferred fabricator. The company cites its tight cutting tolerance and finished edges as key differentiators.
